nodes.label: Extension id pinning for OAuth redirect
nodes.norm_label: extension id pinning for oauth redirect
nodes.rationale: Unpacked loads derive id from folder path, so redirect chromiumapp.org URL mismatches unless key is pinned.

nodes.label: Hand-rolled PKCE OAuth
nodes.rationale: chrome.identity.launchWebAuthFlow + two fetches keeps zero runtime deps; refresh on demand since MV3 workers die between requests.

nodes.label: graphify --watch auto-rebuild
nodes.rationale: Debounced; code changes rebuild via AST with no LLM, doc changes flag needs_update.

nodes.label: graphify merge-graphs cross-repo merge
nodes.rationale: Running the skill per subfolder would clobber one graphify-out, so CLI extract per path then merge.

nodes.label: Whisper transcription with domain-hint prompt
nodes.rationale: Agent writes the domain hint itself from god nodes; no extra API call.

nodes.label: Incremental --update re-extraction
nodes.rationale: build_merge replace-on-re-extract drops stale nodes; prune_sources only for deleted files.

nodes.label: graphify reference: incremental update and cluster-only
nodes.norm_label: graphify reference: incremental update and cluster-only

nodes.label: Understood-as prompt rule
nodes.rationale: Ambiguous or typo-ridden requests open with one cleaned-up restatement, then proceed without waiting.

nodes.label: Discrete confidence_score rubric
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; avoids collapse to 0.5.

nodes.label: Node ID format (full repo-relative stem)
nodes.rationale: Must match AST extractor IDs, otherwise ghost-duplicate nodes appear.

nodes.label: Constrained query expansion against graph vocabulary
nodes.norm_label: constrained query expansion against graph vocabulary
nodes.rationale: Query matcher has no stemming or synonyms; expand only with tokens from the graph vocab.

nodes.label: Build graph, cluster, analyze (Step 4)
nodes.rationale: Empty extraction must not clobber a good graph.json; shrink-guard #479.

nodes.label: Fast path: query existing graph
nodes.rationale: If graph.json exists and the request is a question, skip extraction and run graphify query.

nodes.label: Manifest save and cost tracker (Step 9)
nodes.rationale: Only stamp semantic files that produced output so failed chunks are re-queued (#2015).

nodes.label: Semantic extraction via parallel subagents (Part B)
nodes.norm_label: semantic extraction via parallel subagents (part b)
nodes.rationale: Only content files go to subagents; code is covered by AST to avoid re-reading sources.

nodes.label: GET /health
nodes.rationale: Public; 503 only when DB URL set and select 1 fails; db disabled still 200.

nodes.label: Per-user in-memory rate limit (60/min)
nodes.rationale: In-memory Map per isolate, so real ceiling is 60/min x live instances.

nodes.label: Typed background-worker messaging protocol
nodes.rationale: API calls stay in the worker: host_permissions exempt CORS and avoid mixed content; sender url read from onMessage sender to prevent forgery.

nodes.label: Closed shadow-root translator widget
nodes.rationale: preventDefault on mousedown keeps focus in the page field; automation needs CDP pierce to click it.

nodes.label: detections.verified feedback
nodes.rationale: Written by POST /translate: null = closed, true = detected lang used, false = user overrode. Matched by hashing text in SQL with ::text::bytea.

nodes.label: dev-gateway Supabase gateway emulation
nodes.rationale: Emulates /functions/v1 prefixes, gateway 401 bodies and signature check (ES256/RS256 via JWKS, HS256 dev tokens); can drift, so dev:api:edge before deploy.

nodes.label: Wrong keyboard layout (mistyped + switchLayout)
nodes.rationale: Client re-types locally with a key-position map: free and can't hallucinate.

nodes.label: Paste-first selection replacement
nodes.rationale: Model-based editors (CKEditor, Lexical, ProseMirror) revert DOM edits but handle paste; fallback execCommand insertText preserves undo.

nodes.label: profiles table
nodes.rationale: auth.users belongs to GoTrue; app columns go on profiles, populated by on_auth_user_created trigger; settings merged over DEFAULT_SETTINGS so no data migration.

nodes.label: Settings cache (server-authoritative)
nodes.rationale: Settings live on profiles.settings to follow the user across devices; chrome.storage is a fast offline cache. API first, cache second; last write wins.

nodes.label: trace_id generated sha256 column
nodes.rationale: Fingerprints selected text so all attempts (translations, detections, corrections, rewrites) join without foreign keys.

nodes.label: verify_jwt gateway gate
nodes.rationale: verify_jwt is per-function and enforced before the handler, so health is a separate function; userIdFrom decodes without verifying because the gateway already did.

nodes.label: waitUntil DB save
nodes.rationale: Keeps the isolate alive until the insert lands; saving never fails the request.

nodes.label: AI Translator playground page
nodes.rationale: Manual test page with one of each field type: text input, textarea, contenteditable, and an ignored password input.

nodes.label: Options page HTML (AI Translator settings)
nodes.rationale: open_in_tab options page mounting a React root from main.tsx.

nodes.label: deno.json + devDependencies dual lists
nodes.rationale: Edge Functions have no package.json support; devDependencies let vitest and tsc resolve the same specifiers. Bump both together.

nodes.label: Extension is frontend only
nodes.rationale: Translation and provider selection live in the API because a provider key shipped in the extension is public.

nodes.label: Unauthenticated derived from 401 status
nodes.rationale: Gateway 401 bodies are {code,message}, not {error:{...}}, so the extension reads the status to show the sign-in prompt.

nodes.label: Layered API architecture
nodes.rationale: entrypoint -> wiring -> middleware -> controller -> service -> repository -> db; each layer calls only the one below.

nodes.label: Three entrypoints, one app
nodes.rationale: Only index.ts, health.ts and server.ts know the runtime; app.ts never branches on runtime.

nodes.label: http.ts shared helpers (fail, waitUntil, requestId, benchmark, AppEnv)
nodes.norm_label: http.ts shared helpers (fail, waituntil, requestid, benchmark, appenv)

nodes.label: Error body {error:{message, code}} synced with shared/contract.ts
nodes.norm_label: error body {error:{message, code}} synced with shared/contract.ts
nodes.rationale: Gateway 401 has a different shape, so the extension reads 401 from the status.

nodes.label: Connection layer (db.ts)
nodes.rationale: Single sql pool and checkDb(); knows no table.

nodes.label: Controller layer
nodes.rationale: Owns the whole per-route body and its own response; only controllers call repositories.

nodes.label: A controller owns its own response
nodes.norm_label: a controller owns its own response
nodes.rationale: Helpers return data; repetition across provider routes is deliberate so the route reads in one file.

nodes.label: Entrypoint layer (index.ts, server.ts, health.ts)
nodes.rationale: Only place that knows which runtime it is on.

nodes.label: Erasable TypeScript constraint
nodes.rationale: Deno runs TS directly with no build step: no enums, no parameter properties.

nodes.label: Layered API architecture (each layer calls only the one below)
nodes.norm_label: layered api architecture (each layer calls only the one below)
nodes.rationale: Keeps each route readable top to bottom and lets tests mock by module path.

nodes.label: Middleware layer (requireUser, rateLimit, validate)
nodes.rationale: Guards produce 401/429/400 and must not touch the DB or a provider.

nodes.label: Repository layer
nodes.rationale: Record-to-column mapping and SQL; no-ops when sql is null so vitest and keyless runs work; just throws.

nodes.label: A route is a sentence in app.ts
nodes.norm_label: a route is a sentence in app.ts
nodes.rationale: Guards first; rateLimit after requireUser because it counts per user id, and only on provider routes.

nodes.label: Saving never fails the request
nodes.rationale: waitUntil plus .catch logging stay in the controller so the log line carries the controller request id.

nodes.label: Service layer (translate.ts, detect.ts)
nodes.rationale: One provider call, body in / result out; no logging, saving or HTTP knowledge.

nodes.label: userIdFrom() decodes but does not verify JWT
nodes.norm_label: useridfrom() decodes but does not verify jwt
nodes.rationale: Gateway verify_jwt=true already checked the signature; disabling it without verification makes sub forgeable.

nodes.label: Validation happens once at the boundary
nodes.norm_label: validation happens once at the boundary
nodes.rationale: Controllers read c.get(body) and trust it; nothing re-validates downstream.

nodes.label: Wiring layer (app.ts)
nodes.rationale: Owns CORS, the route table and notFound; never branches on runtime or does work.
